يستغرقوا (form X)
# يَسْتَغْرِقُوا (yastaḡriqū) /jas.taɣ.ri.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
# يُسْتَغْرَقُوا (yustaḡraqū) /jus.taɣ.ra.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
